session.why: the scheduled run drew claude-opus-ultracode, waited 2h07m for the five-hour window before scouting, then scouted and planned (Opus 5.5). Its first build call died 23.8 min in on a network error (API Error: Can't reach the API server - ENOTFOUND, $17.36, the scaffold written and nothing else) and the runner parked for the next window (13:10 PT). The scheduler's PT6H cap had already killed the PowerShell wrapper at noon; the runner survived as an orphan. At 12:32 PT the founder asked for the day to be taken over in a Claude Code session and for a VIDEO template (most recent days shipped stills). The session stopped the orphan runner (taskkill 24684 at 12:35 PT), kept the scout's pick and the brief, and turned the brief's still into a clip (20-brief.md, takeover addendum). No roster slot was drawn for the session
